name: stralforsmcp
description: Connects Claude Desktop to a hosted Stralfors MCP server using your personal token.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Address of the hosted server, for example https://mcp.example.com/mcp

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Your personal token (starts with smcp_). Stored in the operating system secure store.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show who the token belongs to.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the channels available to you.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Show the validation rules of a channel in readable form.

tools.name: get_example_invoice
tools.description: Show the example invoice payload for one or more channels.

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Dry-run an invoice document and explain the findings. Creates nothing.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Send an invoice to the Stralfors test environment (test only, when the server allows writes).

tools.name: track_document
tools.description: Read the delivery status of an invoice.

tools.name: channel_lookup
tools.description: Check which lookup channels can reach a recipient (test environment only).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the knowledge notes about the Stralfors API.
